svg.title: A parameter ensemble by vmap over one compiled evaluator
svg.desc: Panel a: a 45 by 45 grid of two parameters, producer growth rate against inflow nutrient, coloured by the producer concentration at the final time; a marker shows the nominal pair. Panel b: producer concentration over time with the 5th to 95th percentile band across the 2025 members, their median, and a dashed line for a separately computed NumPy run at the nominal parameters.
